_comment: Tier 3 (manual) structural diff recipes for scripts/deps/run-pipelines.sh. Every output uses kind 'tsv-header' with compareColumns [] so only the column header (schema) is compared; value-level drift is expected between a fresh SRA pull and the committed mini fixtures and is reported informationally, not as a failure. Golden paths point at the committed mini fixture files directly (goldens.json's {set} substitution is not used here); run-pipelines.sh lays out the candidate directory as <candidate>/<recipe id>/<output name>. See docs/release/dependency-sweep.md step 4 (tier 3).
